import math

int locate(string needle, string[] haystack)
    for: 0 <= k < int(#haystack)
        if haystack[k] == needle
            return k
    return -1

int money_value(string value)
    parts := value.split(".")
    whole := int(parts[0])
    cents := int(parts[1])
    return whole * 100 + cents

string money(int value)
    return "{value / 100}.{value % 100:02.}"

string signed_money(int value)
    return (if value > 0 then "+" elif value < 0 then "-" else "") + money(math.abs(value))

string percentage(int part, int whole)
    return money(part * 10000 / whole) + "%"

string rate_text(int value)
    return "{value / 10000}.{value % 10000:04.}"

int[] equal_distribution(int total, int count)
    return [for k := (0:<int(count))[] then total / count + (if k < total % count then 1 else 0)]

int[] largest_remainder(int total, int[] weights)
    whole := weights.sum()
    int[] result := []
    int[] order := []
    for: 0 <= k < int(#weights)
        result = result.append(total * weights[k] / whole)
        order = order.append(k)
        p := k
        while p > 0 and total * weights[k] % whole > total * weights[order[p - 1]] % whole
            order[p] = order[p - 1]
            p -= 1
        order[p] = k
    remainder := total - result.sum()
    for: 0 <= k < remainder
        result[order[k]] += 1
    return result

class Member(string name, bool active, int status_day)
class Expense(string id, int day, int record, string[] payers, int[] payments, int amount, string currency, string category, string mode, string[] participants, int[] specified, int total, int[] shares, int[] contributions, int interval, int next_day, int copies)
class Settlement(int day, int record, string sender, string receiver, int amount, string currency, int total)
class Ledger()
    current_day := 1
    serial := 0
    Member[] members := []
    string[] currency_codes := []
    int[] rates := []
    Expense[] expenses := []
    Settlement[] settlements := []
    string[] budget_categories := []
    int[] budgets := []
    string[] used_ids := []

int member_id(const Ledger state, string name)
    for: 0 <= k < int(#state.members)
        if state.members[k].name == name
            return k
    return -1

int expense_id(const Ledger state, string reference)
    for: 0 <= k < int(#state.expenses)
        if state.expenses[k].id == reference
            return k
    return -1

string[] member_names(const Ledger state, active_only := false)
    result := [for member := state.members[] if not active_only or member.active then member.name]
    return result.sorted()

string member_problem(const Ledger state, string name)
    k := member_id(state, name)
    if k < 0
        return "ERROR unknown member " + name
    if not state.members[k].active
        return "ERROR inactive member " + name
    return ""

string frozen_member(const Ledger state, const Expense expense)
    for name := expense.payers.concat(expense.participants)[]
        if not state.members[member_id(state, name)].active
            return name
    return ""

int current_rate(const Ledger state, string code)
    if code == ""
        return 10000
    k := locate(code, state.currency_codes)
    return if k < 0 then -1 else state.rates[k]

int converted_total(int amount, int rate)
    return (amount * rate + 5000) / 10000

Expense computed(const Expense original, int rate)
    result := original
    result.total = converted_total(result.amount, rate)
    portions := result.specified
    if result.mode == "EQUAL"
        portions = equal_distribution(result.amount, int(#result.participants))
    elif result.mode == "PERCENT" or result.mode == "SHARES"
        portions = largest_remainder(result.amount, result.specified)
    elif result.mode == "ADJUST"
        base := equal_distribution(result.amount - result.specified.sum(), int(#result.participants))
        portions = base + result.specified
    result.shares = largest_remainder(result.total, portions)
    result.contributions = largest_remainder(result.total, result.payments)
    return result

string currency_note(int amount, string code)
    return if code == "" then "" else " [" + money(amount) + " " + code + "]"

int[] expense_net(const Ledger state, const Expense expense)
    result := array(#state.members, fill = 0)
    for: 0 <= k < int(#expense.payers)
        result[member_id(state, expense.payers[k])] += expense.contributions[k]
    for: 0 <= k < int(#expense.participants)
        result[member_id(state, expense.participants[k])] -= expense.shares[k]
    return result

int[] balances_of(const Ledger state)
    result := array(#state.members, fill = 0)
    for expense := state.expenses[]
        result = result + expense_net(state, expense)
    for settlement := state.settlements[]
        result[member_id(state, settlement.sender)] += settlement.total
        result[member_id(state, settlement.receiver)] -= settlement.total
    return result

bool involved(const Expense expense, string name)
    return locate(name, expense.payers) >= 0 or locate(name, expense.participants) >= 0

int spent(const Ledger state, string category)
    result := 0
    for expense := state.expenses[]
        if expense.category == category
            result += expense.total
    return result

string[] warning(const Ledger state, string category)
    k := locate(category, state.budget_categories)
    if k >= 0
        excess := spent(state, category) - state.budgets[k]
        if excess > 0
            return ["  WARNING " + category + " over budget by " + money(excess)]
    return []

string expense_result(const Expense expense, string command, payer_list := false)
    names := if payer_list then expense.payers else expense.participants
    amounts := if payer_list then expense.contributions else expense.shares
    parts := [for k := (nat(0):<#names)[] then names[k] + " " + money(amounts[k])]
    return command + " " + expense.id + " " + money(expense.total) + currency_note(expense.amount, expense.currency) + " = " + parts.join(" + ")

int[] chronological(const Ledger state)
    int[] order := []
    for: 0 <= k < int(#state.expenses)
        order = order.append(k)
        p := k
        while p > 0
            earlier := state.expenses[order[p - 1]]
            current := state.expenses[k]
            if earlier.day < current.day or (earlier.day == current.day and earlier.record < current.record)
                break
            order[p] = order[p - 1]
            p -= 1
        order[p] = k
    return order

int[][] debts_of(const Ledger state)
    int[][] raw := array(#state.members, fill = array(#state.members, fill = 0))
    names := member_names(state)
    for expense := state.expenses[]
        net := expense_net(state, expense)
        int[] borrowers := []
        int[] lenders := []
        for name := names[]
            k := member_id(state, name)
            if net[k] < 0
                borrowers = borrowers.append(k)
            elif net[k] > 0
                lenders = lenders.append(k)
        b := 0
        l := 0
        while b < int(#borrowers) and l < int(#lenders)
            sender := borrowers[b]
            receiver := lenders[l]
            amount := math.min(-net[sender], net[receiver])
            raw[sender][receiver] += amount
            net[sender] += amount
            net[receiver] -= amount
            if net[sender] == 0
                b += 1
            if net[receiver] == 0
                l += 1
    for settlement := state.settlements[]
        raw[member_id(state, settlement.sender)][member_id(state, settlement.receiver)] -= settlement.total
    int[][] result := array(#state.members, fill = array(#state.members, fill = 0))
    for: 0 <= r < int(#state.members)
        for: 0 <= c < int(#state.members)
            result[r][c] = raw[r][c] - raw[c][r]
    return result

class HistoryItem(int day, int record, string label, int change)

string[] history_of(const Ledger state, string name)
    HistoryItem[] items := []
    member := member_id(state, name)
    for expense := state.expenses[]
        if involved(expense, name)
            items = items.append(HistoryItem(expense.day, expense.record, expense.id, expense_net(state, expense)[member]))
    for settlement := state.settlements[]
        if settlement.sender == name or settlement.receiver == name
            change := if settlement.sender == name then settlement.total else -settlement.total
            items = items.append(HistoryItem(settlement.day, settlement.record, settlement.sender + "->" + settlement.receiver, change))
    for: 1 <= k < int(#items)
        current := items[k]
        p := k
        while p > 0 and (items[p - 1].day > current.day or (items[p - 1].day == current.day and items[p - 1].record > current.record))
            items[p] = items[p - 1]
            p -= 1
        items[p] = current
    result := ["HISTORY " + name]
    running := 0
    for item := items[]
        running += item.change
        result = result.append("  day " + string(item.day) + " " + item.label + " " + signed_money(item.change) + " balance " + signed_money(running))
    return if #items == 0 then result.append("  (none)") else result

string[] greedy_transfers(string[] names, int[] amounts, string indent)
    remaining := amounts
    string[] result := []
    while true
        sender := -1
        receiver := -1
        for: 0 <= k < int(#names)
            if remaining[k] < 0 and (sender < 0 or remaining[k] < remaining[sender])
                sender = k
            if remaining[k] > 0 and (receiver < 0 or remaining[k] > remaining[receiver])
                receiver = k
        if sender < 0
            break
        amount := math.min(-remaining[sender], remaining[receiver])
        result = result.append(indent + names[sender] + " -> " + names[receiver] + " " + money(amount))
        remaining[sender] += amount
        remaining[receiver] -= amount
    return result

bool subset_of(int subset, int mask, int[] powers)
    for power := powers[]
        if subset / power % 2 == 1 and mask / power % 2 == 0
            return false
    return true

int[] subset_indices(int mask, int[] powers)
    return [for k := (0:<int(#powers))[] if mask / powers[k] % 2 == 1 then k]

bool lex_before(int[] left, int[] right)
    for: 0 <= k < math.min(int(#left), int(#right))
        if left[k] != right[k]
            return left[k] < right[k]
    return #left < #right

string[] simplify(const Ledger state, bool optimal)
    balances := balances_of(state)
    string[] names := []
    int[] amounts := []
    for name := member_names(state)[]
        amount := balances[member_id(state, name)]
        if amount != 0
            names = names.append(name)
            amounts = amounts.append(amount)
    if not optimal
        transfers := greedy_transfers(names, amounts, "  ")
        return ["SIMPLIFY GREEDY transfers " + string(#transfers)].concat(transfers)
    count := int(#names)
    if count > 12
        return ["ERROR too many members"]
    int[] powers := []
    size := 1
    for: 0 <= k < count
        powers = powers.append(size)
        size *= 2
    sums := array(nat(size), fill = 0)
    dp := array(nat(size), fill = 0)
    for: 1 <= mask < size
        best := 0
        sum_found := false
        for: 0 <= k < count
            if mask / powers[k] % 2 == 1
                prior := mask - powers[k]
                best = math.max(best, dp[prior])
                if not sum_found
                    sums[mask] = sums[prior] + amounts[k]
                    sum_found = true
        dp[mask] = best + (if sums[mask] == 0 then 1 else 0)
    mask := size - 1
    string[] output := []
    transfer_count := 0
    groups := 0
    while mask > 0
        first := subset_indices(mask, powers)[0]
        selected := -1
        int[] best_members := []
        for: 1 <= candidate < size
            if candidate / powers[first] % 2 == 0 or sums[candidate] != 0
                continue
            if not subset_of(candidate, mask, powers)
                continue
            if 1 + dp[mask - candidate] != dp[mask]
                continue
            members := subset_indices(candidate, powers)
            if selected < 0 or lex_before(members, best_members)
                selected = candidate
                best_members = members
        string[] group_names := names[best_members]
        int[] group_amounts := amounts[best_members]
        output = output.append("  group " + group_names.join(" "))
        transfers := greedy_transfers(group_names, group_amounts, "    ")
        output = output.concat(transfers)
        transfer_count += int(#transfers)
        groups += 1
        mask -= selected
    return ["SIMPLIFY OPTIMAL transfers " + string(transfer_count) + " groups " + string(groups)].concat(output)

string[] execute(string input_line, Ledger &state)
    fields := input_line.split(" ")
    command := fields[0]
    if command == "MEMBER"
        name := fields[1]
        k := member_id(state, name)
        if k >= 0 and state.members[k].active
            return ["ERROR duplicate member " + name]
        rejoined := k >= 0
        if rejoined
            state.members[k].active = true
            state.members[k].status_day = state.current_day
        else
            state.members = state.members.append(Member(name, true, state.current_day))
        return ["MEMBER " + name + (if rejoined then " rejoined" else " joined")]
    if command == "LEAVE"
        name := fields[1]
        problem := member_problem(state, name)
        if problem != ""
            return [problem]
        k := member_id(state, name)
        if balances_of(state)[k] != 0
            return ["ERROR member has a balance " + name]
        state.members[k].active = false
        state.members[k].status_day = state.current_day
        return ["LEAVE " + name]
    if command == "CURRENCY"
        code := fields[1]
        rate := int(fields[2])
        k := locate(code, state.currency_codes)
        result := "CURRENCY " + code + " " + rate_text(rate)
        if k >= 0
            result += " was " + rate_text(state.rates[k])
            state.rates[k] = rate
        else
            state.currency_codes = state.currency_codes.append(code)
            state.rates = state.rates.append(rate)
        return [result]
    if command == "EXPENSE" or command == "EDIT"
        reference := fields[1]
        existing := expense_id(state, reference)
        if command == "EXPENSE"
            if locate(reference, state.used_ids) >= 0
                return ["ERROR duplicate id " + reference]
        else
            if existing < 0
                return ["ERROR unknown expense " + reference]
            inactive := frozen_member(state, state.expenses[existing])
            if inactive != ""
                return ["ERROR inactive member " + inactive]
        problem := member_problem(state, fields[2])
        if problem != ""
            return [problem]
        amount_spec := fields[3].split("@")
        amount := money_value(amount_spec[0])
        code := if #amount_spec == 1 then "" else amount_spec[1]
        rate := current_rate(state, code)
        if rate < 0
            return ["ERROR unknown currency " + code]
        if amount == 0 or converted_total(amount, rate) == 0
            return ["ERROR invalid amount"]
        mode := fields[5]
        string[] participants := []
        int[] specified := []
        if mode == "EQUAL" and fields[6] == "ALL"
            participants = member_names(state, true)
            specified = array(#participants, fill = 0)
        else
            for: 6 <= k < int(#fields)
                part := fields[k].split(":")
                name := part[0]
                problem = member_problem(state, name)
                if problem != ""
                    return [problem]
                if locate(name, participants) >= 0
                    return ["ERROR duplicate member " + name]
                participants = participants.append(name)
                value := 0
                if #part == 2
                    if mode == "PERCENT" or mode == "SHARES"
                        value = int(part[1])
                    else
                        value = money_value(part[1])
                specified = specified.append(value)
        whole := specified.sum()
        if (mode == "EXACT" and whole != amount) or (mode == "PERCENT" and whole != 10000) or (mode == "SHARES" and whole < 1) or (mode == "ADJUST" and whole > amount)
            return ["ERROR splits do not add up"]
        expense := Expense(reference, state.current_day, state.serial + 1, [fields[2]], [amount], amount, code, fields[4], mode, participants, specified, 0, [], [], 0, 0, 0)
        if command == "EDIT"
            old := state.expenses[existing]
            expense.day = old.day
            expense.record = old.record
            expense.interval = old.interval
            expense.next_day = old.next_day
            expense.copies = old.copies
        expense = computed(expense, rate)
        if command == "EXPENSE"
            state.serial += 1
            state.expenses = state.expenses.append(expense)
            state.used_ids = state.used_ids.append(reference)
        else
            state.expenses[existing] = expense
        return [expense_result(expense, command)].concat(warning(state, expense.category))
    if command == "PAYERS" or command == "DELETE" or command == "RECURRING" or command == "SHOW"
        reference := fields[1]
        k := expense_id(state, reference)
        if k < 0
            return ["ERROR unknown expense " + reference]
        expense := state.expenses[k]
        if command == "PAYERS" or command == "DELETE"
            inactive := frozen_member(state, expense)
            if inactive != ""
                return ["ERROR inactive member " + inactive]
        if command == "DELETE"
            state.expenses = state.expenses[:<k].concat(state.expenses[k + 1:])
            return ["DELETE " + reference]
        if command == "PAYERS"
            string[] payers := []
            int[] payments := []
            for: 2 <= j < int(#fields)
                part := fields[j].split(":")
                problem := member_problem(state, part[0])
                if problem != ""
                    return [problem]
                if locate(part[0], payers) >= 0
                    return ["ERROR duplicate member " + part[0]]
                payers = payers.append(part[0])
                payments = payments.append(money_value(part[1]))
            if payments.sum() != expense.amount
                return ["ERROR payers do not add up"]
            expense.payers = payers
            expense.payments = payments
            expense.contributions = largest_remainder(expense.total, payments)
            state.expenses[k] = expense
            return [expense_result(expense, "PAYERS", true)]
        if command == "RECURRING"
            interval := int(fields[2])
            state.expenses[k].interval = interval
            state.expenses[k].next_day = if interval == 0 then 0 else state.current_day + interval
            return ["RECURRING " + reference + (if interval == 0 then " stopped" else " interval " + string(interval) + " next " + string(state.expenses[k].next_day))]
        output := ["SHOW " + reference, "  day " + string(expense.day) + " category " + expense.category + " mode " + expense.mode + " total " + money(expense.total) + currency_note(expense.amount, expense.currency)]
        for: 0 <= j < int(#expense.payers)
            output = output.append("  paid " + expense.payers[j] + " " + money(expense.contributions[j]))
        for: 0 <= j < int(#expense.participants)
            suffix := ""
            value := expense.specified[j]
            if expense.mode == "EXACT"
                suffix = " " + money(value)
            elif expense.mode == "PERCENT"
                suffix = " " + money(value) + "%"
            elif expense.mode == "SHARES"
                suffix = " " + string(value) + "/" + string(expense.specified.sum())
            elif expense.mode == "ADJUST"
                suffix = " +" + money(value)
            output = output.append("  share " + expense.participants[j] + " " + money(expense.shares[j]) + suffix)
        if expense.interval > 0
            output = output.append("  recurring interval " + string(expense.interval) + " next " + string(expense.next_day))
        return output
    if command == "SETTLE"
        for: 1 <= k <= 2
            problem := member_problem(state, fields[k])
            if problem != ""
                return [problem]
        if fields[1] == fields[2]
            return ["ERROR same member " + fields[1]]
        amount_spec := fields[3].split("@")
        amount := money_value(amount_spec[0])
        code := if #amount_spec == 1 then "" else amount_spec[1]
        rate := current_rate(state, code)
        if rate < 0
            return ["ERROR unknown currency " + code]
        total := converted_total(amount, rate)
        if amount == 0 or total == 0
            return ["ERROR invalid amount"]
        state.serial += 1
        state.settlements = state.settlements.append(Settlement(state.current_day, state.serial, fields[1], fields[2], amount, code, total))
        return ["SETTLE " + fields[1] + " -> " + fields[2] + " " + money(total) + currency_note(amount, code)]
    if command == "BUDGET"
        category := fields[1]
        amount := money_value(fields[2])
        k := locate(category, state.budget_categories)
        if amount == 0
            if k >= 0
                state.budget_categories = state.budget_categories[:<k].concat(state.budget_categories[k + 1:])
                state.budgets = state.budgets[:<k].concat(state.budgets[k + 1:])
            return ["BUDGET " + category + " removed"]
        if k < 0
            state.budget_categories = state.budget_categories.append(category)
            state.budgets = state.budgets.append(amount)
        else
            state.budgets[k] = amount
        return ["BUDGET " + category + " " + money(amount)]
    if command == "DAY"
        day := int(fields[1])
        if day <= state.current_day
            return ["ERROR invalid day " + fields[1]]
        output := ["DAY " + string(day)]
        while true
            selected := -1
            for: 0 <= k < int(#state.expenses)
                candidate := state.expenses[k]
                if candidate.interval == 0 or candidate.next_day > day
                    continue
                if selected < 0 or candidate.next_day < state.expenses[selected].next_day or (candidate.next_day == state.expenses[selected].next_day and candidate.record < state.expenses[selected].record)
                    selected = k
            if selected < 0
                break
            template := state.expenses[selected]
            rate := current_rate(state, template.currency)
            if frozen_member(state, template) != "" or converted_total(template.amount, rate) == 0
                state.expenses[selected].interval = 0
                state.expenses[selected].next_day = 0
                output = output.append("  CANCEL " + template.id)
            else
                state.expenses[selected].copies += 1
                state.expenses[selected].next_day += template.interval
                copy := template
                copy.id = template.id + "#" + string(template.copies + 2)
                copy.day = template.next_day
                state.serial += 1
                copy.record = state.serial
                copy.interval = 0
                copy.next_day = 0
                copy.copies = 0
                copy = computed(copy, rate)
                state.expenses = state.expenses.append(copy)
                state.used_ids = state.used_ids.append(copy.id)
                output = output.append("  RECUR " + copy.id + " " + money(copy.total)).concat(warning(state, copy.category))
        state.current_day = day
        return output
    if command == "SIMPLIFY"
        return simplify(state, fields[1] == "OPTIMAL")
    if command == "OWES" or command == "HISTORY" or (command == "EXPENSES" and fields[1] == "MEMBER")
        name := fields[if command == "EXPENSES" then 2 else 1]
        if member_id(state, name) < 0
            return ["ERROR unknown member " + name]
    if command == "HISTORY"
        return history_of(state, fields[1])
    if command == "BALANCES"
        balances := balances_of(state)
        output := ["BALANCES"]
        for name := member_names(state, true)[]
            output = output.append("  " + name + " " + signed_money(balances[member_id(state, name)]))
        return if #output == 1 then output.append("  (none)") else output
    if command == "OWES"
        debts := debts_of(state)
        name := fields[1]
        k := member_id(state, name)
        output := ["OWES " + name]
        for other := member_names(state)[]
            amount := debts[k][member_id(state, other)]
            if amount > 0
                output = output.append("  " + name + " owes " + other + " " + money(amount))
            elif amount < 0
                output = output.append("  " + other + " owes " + name + " " + money(-amount))
        return if #output == 1 then output.append("  (none)") else output
    if command == "MATRIX"
        names := member_names(state, true)
        if #names == 0
            return ["MATRIX", "  (none)"]
        debts := debts_of(state)
        label_width := 0
        cell_width := 0
        string[][] cells := []
        for name := names[]
            label_width = math.max(label_width, int(#name))
            cell_width = math.max(cell_width, int(#name))
            string[] row := []
            for other := names[]
                amount := math.max(0, debts[member_id(state, name)][member_id(state, other)])
                cell := if name == other then "-" else money(amount)
                cell_width = math.max(cell_width, int(#cell))
                row = row.append(cell)
            cells = cells.append(row)
        string heading := " " * nat(label_width)
        for name := names[]
            heading += "  " + " " * nat(cell_width - int(#name)) + name
        output := ["MATRIX", heading]
        for: 0 <= k < int(#names)
            string row := names[k] + " " * nat(label_width - int(#names[k]))
            for cell := cells[k][]
                row += "  " + " " * nat(cell_width - int(#cell)) + cell
            output = output.append(row)
        return output
    if command == "MEMBERS" or command == "TOTALS"
        output := [command]
        for name := member_names(state)[]
            k := member_id(state, name)
            member := state.members[k]
            count := 0
            paid := 0
            share := 0
            sent := 0
            received := 0
            for expense := state.expenses[]
                if involved(expense, name)
                    count += 1
                payer := locate(name, expense.payers)
                participant := locate(name, expense.participants)
                if payer >= 0
                    paid += expense.contributions[payer]
                if participant >= 0
                    share += expense.shares[participant]
            for settlement := state.settlements[]
                if settlement.sender == name
                    sent += settlement.total
                if settlement.receiver == name
                    received += settlement.total
            if command == "MEMBERS"
                output = output.append("  " + name + (if member.active then " active day " else " left day ") + string(member.status_day) + " expenses " + string(count))
            else
                output = output.append("  " + name + " paid " + money(paid) + " share " + money(share) + " sent " + money(sent) + " received " + money(received))
        if command == "MEMBERS"
            return if #output == 1 then output.append("  (none)") else output
        for code := state.currency_codes.sorted()[]
            count := 0
            amount := 0
            total := 0
            for expense := state.expenses[]
                if expense.currency == code
                    count += 1
                    amount += expense.amount
                    total += expense.total
            if count > 0
                output = output.append("  currency " + code + " expenses " + string(count) + " amount " + money(amount) + " base " + money(total))
        total := 0
        settlement_total := 0
        for expense := state.expenses[]
            total += expense.total
        for settlement := state.settlements[]
            settlement_total += settlement.total
        return output.append("  expenses " + string(#state.expenses) + " total " + money(total) + " settlements " + string(#state.settlements) + " total " + money(settlement_total))
    if command == "BUDGETS"
        output := ["BUDGETS"]
        for category := state.budget_categories.sorted()[]
            amount := state.budgets[locate(category, state.budget_categories)]
            total := spent(state, category)
            output = output.append("  " + category + " spent " + money(total) + " budget " + money(amount) + " used " + percentage(total, amount) + (if total <= amount then " left " else " over ") + money(math.abs(amount - total)))
        return if #output == 1 then output.append("  (none)") else output
    if command == "CATEGORY"
        string[] categories := []
        grand_total := 0
        for expense := state.expenses[]
            if locate(expense.category, categories) < 0
                categories = categories.append(expense.category)
            grand_total += expense.total
        categories = categories.sorted()
        category_totals := [for category := categories[] then spent(state, category)]
        for: 1 <= k < int(#categories)
            category := categories[k]
            category_total := category_totals[k]
            p := k
            while p > 0 and category_total > category_totals[p - 1]
                categories[p] = categories[p - 1]
                category_totals[p] = category_totals[p - 1]
                p -= 1
            categories[p] = category
            category_totals[p] = category_total
        output := ["CATEGORY"]
        for: 0 <= category_index < int(#categories)
            category := categories[category_index]
            total := category_totals[category_index]
            output = output.append("  " + category + " " + money(total) + " " + percentage(total, grand_total))
            names := member_names(state)
            int[] shares := []
            for name := names[]
                share := 0
                for expense := state.expenses[]
                    if expense.category == category
                        participant := locate(name, expense.participants)
                        if participant >= 0
                            share += expense.shares[participant]
                shares = shares.append(share)
            int[] order := []
            for: 0 <= k < int(#names)
                order = order.append(k)
                p := k
                while p > 0 and shares[k] > shares[order[p - 1]]
                    order[p] = order[p - 1]
                    p -= 1
                order[p] = k
            for k := order[]
                if shares[k] > 0
                    output = output.append("    " + names[k] + " " + money(shares[k]) + " " + percentage(shares[k], total))
        return if #output == 1 then output.append("  (none)") else output
    order := chronological(state)
    if command == "EXPENSES"
        output := [input_line]
        count := 0
        total := 0
        for k := order[]
            expense := state.expenses[k]
            selected := fields[1] == "ALL"
            if fields[1] == "CATEGORY"
                selected = expense.category == fields[2]
            elif fields[1] == "MEMBER"
                selected = involved(expense, fields[2])
            elif fields[1] == "DAYS"
                first_day := int(fields[2])
                last_day := int(fields[3])
                selected = first_day <= expense.day <= last_day
            if selected
                output = output.append("  day " + string(expense.day) + " " + expense.id + " " + expense.category + " " + money(expense.total) + " by " + expense.payers.join(","))
                count += 1
                total += expense.total
        return output.append("  count " + string(count) + " total " + money(total))
    interval := int(fields[1])
    output := ["PERIODS " + string(interval)]
    bucket := -1
    count := 0
    total := 0
    for k := order[]
        expense := state.expenses[k]
        next_bucket := (expense.day - 1) / interval
        if bucket >= 0 and bucket != next_bucket
            output = output.append("  days " + string(bucket * interval + 1) + "-" + string(bucket * interval + interval) + " expenses " + string(count) + " total " + money(total))
            count = 0
            total = 0
        bucket = next_bucket
        count += 1
        total += expense.total
    if bucket >= 0
        output = output.append("  days " + string(bucket * interval + 1) + "-" + string(bucket * interval + interval) + " expenses " + string(count) + " total " + money(total))
    return if #output == 1 then output.append("  (none)") else output

scan(&command_count)
for: 0 <= line_number < command_count
    string input_line
    scan(&input_line)
    for output_line := execute(input_line, &ledger)[]
        println(output_line)
